---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new behaviour or a change to an existing one.
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

Please keep it short — three or four paragraphs at most. Larger
proposals belong in an OpenSpec change proposal under `openspec/`,
not an issue.

## Summary

One sentence describing the feature.

## Use case

Why is this needed? What meeting workflow does it unblock, or what
pain does it remove?

## Proposed approach

Sketch how it would work end-to-end: which config keys change, which
crate module owns the change, what the user sees in the Slint UI.
Point at the relevant files in `src/` if you can.

## Alternatives considered

What else was on the table, and why is the proposed approach better?
"No alternative" is a fine answer if it's true.

## Out of scope

Anything that should *not* ship with this feature, listed so
reviewers don't read it back into the proposal later.
